tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Nnọọ, onye ndú na-eto eto. Abụ m Onye Nkuzi Hoshi. Agbụrụ anyị achọtala ndagwurugwu zoro ezo n'ugwu. Ka anyị wuo obodo ndị iro na-agaghị achọta.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Ebe Ịkpụ Ego gị na-akpụ Ego. Mgbe mkpụrụ ego na-efe n'elu ya, pịa ya, wee pịa Nara.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Agbụrụ na-adabere n'Ego. Pịa Wuo wee tinye Ebe Ịkpụ Ego.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Ugbu a mee ka Obi Agbụrụ sie ike: pịa ụlọ elu ahụ, wee pịa Kwalite.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Nkwalite na-ewe oge. Obi ga-adị njikere n'ime {time}: lọghachi mgbe ahụ, ma ọ bụ pịa Mechaa ugbu a iji jiri ntakịrị Jed.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.finishKeep.done.text: Obi adịla njikere. I mere nke ọma!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Agbụrụ ndị iro ga-awakpo anyị. Wuo Ụlọ Elu Kunai n'akụkụ Obi (Wuo, wee pịa taabụ Nchekwa): ọ na-agba onye mwakpo ọ bụla nọ nso.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Wuo Dojo Ọzụzụ, Ogige Ndị Agha na Ụlọ Elu Kunai n'akụkụ Obi (Wuo: taabụ Agha, wee taabụ Nchekwa).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Mepee ngalaba Agha wee zụọ ụfọdụ Shinobi: mma ọsọ ọsọ na-awakpo ụlọ kacha nso.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ọzụzụ na-ewekwa oge: ndị dike gị ga-adị njikere n'ime {time}. Chere, ma ọ bụ pịa Mechaa ọzụzụ iji jiri ntakịrị Jed.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Mwakpo mbụ gị. Pịa Wakpo, lelee ebe a na-awakpo, wee pịa Wakpo! N'ọgbọ agha, m ga-egosi gị otu ihe n'otu oge: zipu Shinobi gị site n'ebe na-enwu enwu, wee tinye ha n'anwụrụ ọkụ mgbe ha ruru ụlọ elu: ndị dike nọ n'ime anwụrụ ọkụ ka a pụrụ ịgba naanị site nso.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: I lụrụ nke ọma. Mwakpo na-eme ka ebe nchekwa gị jupụta ngwa ngwa: kwalite Obi Agbụrụ (ma ọ bụ ebe nchekwa) ozugbo. Mgbe ahụ kwalite Dojo Ọzụzụ iji meghee Ndị Mmebi Nzuzo: ha na-akpọchi ihe nchekwa ruo sekọnd ole na ole. Kpọchie mbụ, wee wakpo, ma tinye ndị dike gị n'anwụrụ ọkụ ebe ọkụ kacha sie ike. Nara, kwalite, wakpo, ma sonye na Njikọ.

whatsNew.0_1_0.en: What's new: send your squad in with one order, watch the fight up close or faster, and see what another entry point would have done. Every raid on your village now has a report, and you can test your defenses. New: a four-week event calendar with festivals, a weekly Gauntlet, daily contracts, achievements, Keep seals and looks to earn.
whatsNew.0_1_0.text: Ihe ọhụrụ: jiri otu iwu zipụ otu gị, lee ọgụ ahụ nso ma ọ bụ ngwa ngwa, ma hụ ihe ebe mbanye ọzọ gaara eme. Ugbu a, mwakpo ọ bụla e mere obodo gị nwere akụkọ, ị nwekwara ike ịnwale ihe nchekwa gị. Ọhụrụ: kalenda mmemme izu anọ nwere mmemme afọ, Ụzọ Ọnwụnwa kwa izu, nkwekọrịta kwa ụbọchị, ihe ịga nke ọma, akara Obi na ọdịdị ị ga-enweta.

codex.rulesButton.text: Otú mwakpo gị si enweta azịza

codex.rivalsRule.en: Computer rival clans read your last {n} raids: about {pct} of their outposts are tempered against the warriors you used most.
codex.rivalsRule.text: Agbụrụ iro kọmputa na-agụ mwakpo {n} ikpeazụ gị: ihe dị ka {pct} nke ebe nche ha ka a kpụziri megide ndị dike ị na-ejikarị.

codex.exhaustionRule.en: For {hours} hours after each raid your village loses, the next raider can take only {pct} as much (two losses multiply).
codex.exhaustionRule.text: Ruo awa {hours} mgbe mwakpo ọ bụla e meriri obodo gị, onye mwakpo na-esote nwere ike iburu naanị {pct} nke ihe a na-ebukarị (mmeri abụọ na-amụkọ ọnụ).

codex.temperRule.en: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:
codex.temperRule.text: Site na Obi Agbụrụ {level}, a pụrụ ịkpụzi ihe nchekwa: Ogologo na-agba ebe dị anya karịa mana adịghị ike, Mgbawa na-akụ ìgwè mana na-agba nwayọọ, Nche na-ewusi ihe nchekwa ikuku na ọnya ike. Agbụrụ iro ọ bụla na-adabere n'otu ụzọ:

codex.counters.text: {building} na-arụ ọrụ megide {list} (a nwalere ya n'agha).

builders.crewNote.en: The garrison crew builds defenses, traps and support counters without taking a Village Artisan.
builders.crewNote.text: Ndị ọrụ ogige na-ewu ihe nchekwa, ọnya na ụlọ nkwado n'ejighị Onye Ọrụaka Obodo.

review.about.text: Nṅomi: e zigara otu ndị dike na otu iwu ahụ site n'ebe ọzọ. Nke a bụ nyocha mwakpo a, ọ bụghị ihe o kwesịrị inweta.

review.fit.text: Ndị dike {sent} n'ime {total} na-abanye site n'ebe a

squad.armed.en: Tap a glowing ring: the rest of your warriors go in through it.
squad.armed.text: Pịa mgbanaka na-enwu: ndị dike gị fọdụrụ ga-abanye site na ya.

tutorial.skipAsk.en: Skip the guided first steps? You can replay them from Settings.
tutorial.skipAsk.text: Wụfee nzọụkwụ mbụ a na-edu gị? Ị nwere ike ịmegharị ha site na Ntọala.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Otu ihe nrite kwa ụbọchị, otu ihe ahụ maka onye ọ bụla, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ ịkpa ụmụ ma ọ dịghị mgbe a na-ere ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ otu ụbọchị, ọ dịghị ihe na-efu: nnata ọzọ bụ ụbọchị na-esote na ndepụta. Ụbọchị 28 na-enye ọdịdị Obi.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Ọdịdị Obi ọhụrụ bụ nke gị: Ụlọ Ahịa → Ọdịdị.

offers.noAge.text: Onyinye pụrụ iche na-apụta naanị mgbe ị gwara anyị afọ gị (Ntọala → Akaụntụ → Mmefu → Tọọ otu afọ).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Onyinye pụrụ iche anaghị apụta maka ndị egwuregwu na-erubeghị afọ 18. Ihe niile dị na taabụ Jed ka dị n'ime oke mmefu gị.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Nnyefe na-amalite ozugbo: ị nwere ike ịnara ụgwọ mbụ ugbu a na otu ọzọ kwa ụbọchị; site n'ịzụ, ị kwenyere na ị tụfuru ikike ịkagbu, dịka iwu kwere maka ihe dijitalụ.

net.clockOff.en: This device's clock is off by about {minutes} min. Online timers and war phases follow the server: set the clock to automatic in the device settings.

frame.failed.title.en: Something went wrong drawing the village

save.openFailed.body.en: This device didn't open its saved village in time. Try again, or play a temporary village for now: it is not saved and stays offline.
save.openFailed.body.text: Ngwaọrụ a emeghepeghị obodo gị echekwara n'oge. Nwaa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ gwuo obodo nwa oge ugbu a: a naghị echekwa ya ma ọ na-anọ na-enweghị ịntanetị.

store.error.cancelled.text: Akagburu ịzụ ahịa. Ọ dịghị ego e wepụrụ.

store.error.unavailable.text: Ịzụ ahịa adịghị ugbu a. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.

raid.rejected.expiredAt.en: Its report (from the raid on {date}) reached the server after the 72-hour limit.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Ọ dịghị dike lụrụ ọgụ, ya mere a gụrụ ya dịka mmega ahụ.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Kpụzie {building} niile otu mgbe. Ogologo na-agba ebe dị anya karịa mana ọ na-adaba nwayọọ ma na-ebu ụzọ chọọ ndị dike nọ n'azụ; Mgbawa na-akụ otu ìgwè mana ọ na-agba nwayọọ; Nche na-eme ka Ụlọ Elu Ụta Mbara Igwe, Ite Ọkụ Anwụrụ Ilu na ọnya sie ike karịa. Ndị mwakpo na-ahụ ọdịdị ahụ mgbe ha na-enyocha.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Ekpụziela: {building} ọ bụla nwere ọdịdị ọhụrụ ya.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Nche na-emekwa ka ọgwụgwọ, ọmụmụ ọzọ, ike na mkpuchi ọta nke ndị mwakpo dị ala n'ebe niile.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Kwupụta nsonaazụ tupu i wakpo: ruo ya ma buru ihe nkwata karịa laa, ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya ma ghara ibu ihe ọ bụla.

stake.missed.text: E ruteghị nkwa: i kwupụtara {stars}★, ya mere ọ dịghị ihe nkwata lọtara.

carry.preview.text: Usuu agha a ga-ebu {pct} nke ihe nkwata. Otu nwere ọrụ dị iche iche na-ebu karịa.

res.debt.en: You owe {amount} {resource} from a refunded purchase. It is paid back from your future income; nothing else is taken.
res.debt.text: Ị ji ụgwọ sitere n'ịzụ ahịa e weghachiri ego ya: {amount} {resource}. A na-akwụ ya site n'ego mbata gị n'ọdịnihu; ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ a na-ewere.

sync.refused.en: {n, plural, one {The server refused # action because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.} other {The server refused # actions because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.}}
sync.refused.text: {n, plural, other {Sava jụrụ omume # n'ihi na obodo gị agbanweela, dịka ọmụmaatụ na ngwaọrụ ọzọ. Obodo dị na sava bụ nke a na-edebe.}}

news.operators.text: Site n'aka ndị na-arụ egwuregwu ahụ

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Ozi sitere n'aka ndị na-arụ egwuregwu ahụ na-abịa mgbe ị na-egwu n'ịntanetị.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: I gwuchaala na ekwentị a ma ọ bụ ihe nchọgharị a? Wepụ ya. Akaụntụ ịntanetị gị ka dị maka ngwaọrụ gị ndị ọzọ na ụzọ ịbanye ejikọrọ.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Egwuregwu n'ịntanetị ga-agbanyụ ebe a, ngwaọrụ a ga-echefukwa igodo ya nke akaụntụ ịntanetị gị. Obodo dị na ngwaọrụ a ka dị. Iji gwuo akaụntụ ahụ ebe a ọzọ, banye site n'akaụntụ Apple, Google ma ọ bụ Game Center ejikọrọ.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: E wepụla ngwaọrụ a. Egwuregwu n'ịntanetị agbanyụọla ebe a.

account.signOutDevice.pending.en: Not signed out yet: some of your play is still being sent (actions: {actions}, battle reports: {raids}). Try again when the connection is better.
account.signOutDevice.pending.text: A pụbeghị: akụkụ egwuregwu gị ka a na-ezipụ (omume: {actions}, akụkọ agha: {raids}). Nwaa ọzọ mgbe njikọ ka mma.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: E wepụghị ya: ngwaọrụ a nwere naanị igodo akaụntụ ịntanetị gị. Buru ụzọ jikọọ Apple, Google ma ọ bụ Game Center, ma ọ bụ hichapụ akaụntụ ahụ kama.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Akụ ezughị n'obodo gị dị na sava.

news.reason.builder.text: Ọ dịghị Onye Ọrụaka Obodo nọ n'efu.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Ọ nọlarị n'ọkwa kacha elu ya.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.
news.reason.busy.text: A nọlarị na-arụ ọrụ na ya.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Obodo gị agbanwelarị, dịka ọmụmaatụ na ngwaọrụ ọzọ.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Ebe nchekwa ejupụtala nke ukwuu: ịkagbu ugbu a ga-eme ka {lost} n'ime {refund} ị ga-enweta funahụ gị. Buru ụzọ mee ohere.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Ndepụta ndị kacha mma bụ akụkụ egwuregwu n'ịntanetị.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Ndị mwakpo nwere ike iwere {pct} nke ihe dị n'ebe nchekwa gị, ọ karịghị {cap} nke akụ ọ bụla mgbe Obi gị nọ n'ọkwa {level}, na {collectors} nke ihe ebe nnakọta gị anakọtabeghị.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Ọ naghị emepụta ihe ọ bụla mgbe a na-akwalite ya ({time}). Ihe o jidere ugbu a ka dị, a ka nwekwara ike ịnara ya.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, =1 {Emeghela dike ọhụrụ!} other {Emeghela ndị dike ọhụrụ!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Ọzụzụ ndị dike gị dị n'azụ obodo gị karịa otu ọkwa Obi: Obi dị elu na-ezute ndị iro na ndị mwakpo siri ike karịa. Ị ga-ebu ụzọ mee nchọpụta ma ọ bụ zụọ ndị dike?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Ebe nchekwa gị enweghị ike ijide ihe nkwata niile dị ebe a: ihe na-adabaghị ga-efu.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: A gụkwara ọkwa {from} ruo {to} dịka ndị e mechara, a na-akwụ nke ọ bụla otu ugboro.

drill.title.text: Mmega kwa ụbọchị (mmega ahụ: ọ dịghị ihe e mefuru)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Mmega kwa ụbọchị: lụso ebe ike a ọgụ na ogige zuru ezu nke ndị dike gị. Ọ dịghị ihe a na-emefu, mmega mbụ nke taa na-akwụkwa obere ihe nrite.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: Mmega emechaala: a kwụọla ihe nrite nke taa. Ọ dịghị ihe e mefuru.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: A kwụọla ihe nrite mmega nke taa. Ị ka nwere ike ime mmega maka omume; ihe nrite ọzọ ga-abịa echi.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Ọta gị fọdụrụ {time}: iwakpo ga-akwụsị ya.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Igbe kwa ụbọchị mbụ gị adịla njikere: Mechaa ga-emeghe ya.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Nke a enweghị ike imeghe. Lelee njikọ gị wee nwaa ọzọ.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Ụdị Kagemura ọhụrụ apụtala. Bunye ọzọ iji meghee nke a.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Ekwentị a sere agha nwayọọ, ya mere Kagemura ga-eji eserese dị mfe site na mmalite ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya na Ntọala → Eserese.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Usoro sava egwuregwu ahụ zitere. Ngụ oge ọ bụla bụ nke ezi.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Usoro dị n'ime egwuregwu. Ngụ oge ọ bụla bụ nke ezi.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Mmemme na-agbaso kalenda a kpụrụ akpụ: usoro izu anọ na mmemme ọnụ ise n'ụbọchị a kara aka kwa afọ. Oge ha anaghị agbanwe ma ọ bụ agbatị, ya mere ngụ oge bụ nke ezi mgbe niile.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Otu ihe ahụ maka onye ọ bụla taa; nke ọhụrụ n'ime {time}. Ọ na-agbanwe naanị ihe mwakpo e meriri na-ebu laa.

events.gauntlet.generated.text: Ebe ike Ụzọ Ọnwụnwa (nke kọmputa mere).

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Ebe ike kọmputa mere, otu obodo ahụ maka onye ọ bụla nọ n'ọkwa Obi gị n'izu a. Enweghị ihe nkwata n'ime ya; nzọụkwụ kpakpando ọ bụla n'usoro ahụ na-akwụ otu ugboro.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Ebe ike kọmputa mere n'ọkwa Obi gị, otu ihe ahụ na mgbalị ọ bụla. Enweghị ihe nkwata n'ime ya; nzọụkwụ ọ bụla n'usoro ahụ na-akwụ otu ugboro, kpakpando atọ na-enyekwa ọdịdị mmemme ahụ.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Mgbe enyi malitere site na koodu enyi gị ruru Obi ọkwa {keep} na obodo ya dị na sava, onye ọ bụla n'ime unu ga-enweta ihe nrite a kara aka. Ọ dịghị ihe ịkpa ụmụ, ọ dịghịkwa ihe a ga-azụ.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade
growth.invite.reward.text: Ihe nrite maka onye ọ bụla n'ime unu: Jed {jade}

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, other {Ihe nrite maka ihe ruru ndị enyi # kwa ọnwa.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Ndị enyi jiri koodu gị bata: na-eche {waiting}, dị njikere {ready}, enwetala ihe nrite {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: I jiri koodu enyi bata. Ruo Obi ọkwa {keep} na obodo gị dị na sava, unu abụọ ga-enweta ihe nrite ahụ.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: I jiri koodu enyi bata ma rute Obi ọkwa {keep}: ihe nrite gị adịla njikere.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: I jiri koodu enyi bata ma nara ihe nrite gị.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Ihe nrite na-aga n'obodo dị na sava. Bughari obodo gị ebe ahụ na Ntọala → Egwuregwu n'ịntanetị.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Ihe nrite ịkpọ enyi òkù bụ naanị maka ndị okenye. Ị ka nwere ike ịtinye ndị enyi ma gwuo egwu ọnụ.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, other {Tinye koodu enyi ahụ n'ime ụbọchị # ị malitere egwuregwu n'ịntanetị.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, other {Sava na-enyocha nlọghachi a ma debe ya ruo ụbọchị # n'okpuru koodu. Onye ọ bụla nwere njikọ ahụ nwere ike ilele ya. A na-egosi obodo ahụ na-enweghị aha ya, a naghịkwa akpọ aha onye mmegide gị.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: A naghị egosi aha gị na nlọghachi ndị egwuregwu na-erubeghị afọ 18 kerịtara.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Enweghị ike imeghe nlọghachi a kerịtara.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: E dekọrọ nlọghachi a n'okpuru iwu agha ndị ọzọ, ya mere ụdị egwuregwu a enweghị ike igosi ya.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Ọkọlọtọ na-agbanwe naanị ọdịdị Njikọ ahụ: ọ dịghị uru n'agha ma ọ bụ n'akụ.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Ọ na-ezigakwa ọdịiche mpaghara oge gị na UTC, ka a gụọ ụbọchị na kalenda nke gị.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Nlele mbụ: nke a adịbeghị n'egwuregwu dị ndụ.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Họrọ dike agbụrụ ga-esonye na mwakpo gị.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Ọ dịbeghị dike agbụrụ nwere ike isonye. Ndị dike agbụrụ na-esonye site n'ọkwa Obi dị elu.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Jiri ndị dike gị wakpo iji nweta ọkaka.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {n} of {total} buildings at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Akara Obi: ụlọ {n} n'ime {total} eruola ọkwa kacha elu Obi a. Obi zuru ezu na-enweta akara ya.

chat.presetOnly.text: Naanị nkebiokwu a kwadoro akwado ka a na-egosi.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Usoro ọrụ Kagemura malitere ịrụ ọrụ na {date}. Biko gụọ ya ma nabata ya iji gwuo egwu n'ịntanetị. Obodo gị na-aga n'ihu na-arụ ọrụ na ngwaọrụ a n'ụzọ ọ bụla.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Nyere Apple aka ikpebi arịrịọ nkwụghachi ego (gbanyụrụ ruo mgbe ị gbanwụrụ ya)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Mgbe ị rịọrọ Apple nkwụghachi ego, Apple nwere ike ịjụ anyị maka ịzụ ahịa ahụ. Mgbe nke a gbanwụrụ, anyị na-agwa Apple na e nyefere ya ma nye oke maka ogologo oge akaụntụ gị dịworo na ego ole ị zụrụ na nke e weghachiri gị. Ọ bụghị aha gị, obodo gị ma ọ bụ nkata gị. Anyị anaghị arịọ Apple ka ọ jụ nkwụghachi ego.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Kwe ka obodo m pụta na nlọghachi ndị egwuregwu ndị ọzọ kerịtara

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Mgbe mmadụ kerịtara nlọghachi nke mwakpo na obodo gị, ọ na-egosi nhazi obodo gị (ọ bụghị aha gị). Gbanyụọ nke a, a gaghị egosi obodo gị ma ọlị, a ga-ewepụkwa nkerịta e merelarị ya.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Mmelite a na-agbanwe otú Kagemura si arụ ọrụ. Nne na nna ma ọ bụ onye nlekọta nwere ike inyocha ya tupu e jiri ya.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Otu na njedebe oge: {league}. Mwakpo e meriri: {raids}. Kpakpando: {stars}. Ọkwa Mpịakọta: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Mpịakọta Oge agwụla, a gbakwunyekwara ihe nrite ndị ị na-anaraghị:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {Anakọtala ihe nrite mgbakwunye {max} niile n'oge a ({got} n'ime {max})} other {Ọrụ ọ bụla ka na-akwụ ụgwọ: ihe nrite mgbakwunye ọzọ fọdụrụ akara # ({got} n'ime {max} n'oge a)}}

settings.reduceEffects.text: Belata ịma jijiji ihuenyo na ọkụ na-egbu maramara

stake.recentHits.en: Your last {raids} raids: 2★ or more in {two}, 3★ in {three}.
stake.recentHits.text: Mwakpo {raids} ikpeazụ gị: 2★ ma ọ bụ karịa na {two}, 3★ na {three}.

whatsNew.0_2_0.en: What's new: choose a larger text size, and turn screen shake and flashes down, in Settings. The stake picker shows how often your recent raids reached two and three stars. Shadow Trials climb more evenly, and raids at Keep 4 and Keep 15 meet fairer opponents.
whatsNew.0_2_0.text: Ihe ọhụrụ: họrọ nha ederede buru ibu, ma belata ịma jijiji ihuenyo na ọkụ na-egbu maramara na Ntọala. Ihe nhọrọ nzọ na-egosi ugboro ole mwakpo gị ndị na-adịbeghị anya ruru kpakpando abụọ na atọ. Ule Onyinyo na-arị elu nke ọma karị, mwakpo na Ebe Nchekwa 4 na 15 na-ezutekwa ndị mmegide ziri ezi karị.
